messages:
maya: Kicking off first-touch for a new kubeadm GPU cluster in eu-central-2. Want to run a compact runbook here for bootstrap, basic validation, and handoff. I'll call out where we need infra/network/sre checks.

maya: TL;DR checklist I plan to run: VPC/subnet validation -> WireGuard peering -> kubeadm init w/ CRI config -> nodepool join (gpu-taints) -> base addons (coredns, metrics-server, calico) -> smoke (kubectl, nvidia-smi, token latency) -> handoff doc + alerts.

raj: 👍 I can validate VPC and quota. Do you have the subnet CIDRs?

maya: Subnets: 10.120.0.0/19 (control plane), 10.120.32.0/18 (workers). Need BGP/route targets checked because this region will peer to our central peering fabric.

raj: On it. Will check route tables and any overlapping CIDR with prod-east. Also will verify IGW/NAT + egress ranges for image pulls.

sophie: I'll prep nodepool templates. Recommendation: 8x A100-80G for reserved workloads, 4x A10G for burst/spot. We should mark spot nodepool with taint `node.kubernetes.io/spot: true`.

liam: Small networking heads-up: WireGuard MTU needs to be 1420 for this colo -> prevents fragmentation with jumbo disabled. If you run `wg-quick` with default MTU you will see RSTs.

maya: Good call. I'm adding wireguard config snippet to the runbook to enforce MTU and AllowedIPs.

maya: Runbook snippet (control-plane init):
```
# control plane machine: kubeadm config file (minimal)
apiVersion: kubeadm.k8s.io/v1beta3
kind: ClusterConfiguration
etcd:
  local:
    imageRepository: registry.k8s.redwoodeval.io/etcd
networking:
  serviceSubnet: 10.96.0.0/12
  podSubnet: 192.168.0.0/16
controllerManager:
  extraArgs:
    allocate-node-cidrs: "true"
---
apiVersion: kubeadm.k8s.io/v1beta3
kind: InitConfiguration
nodeRegistration:
  criSocket: /var/run/containerd/containerd.sock
  kubeletExtraArgs:
    max-pods: "110"
```

maya: Commands I'll run (control plane):
```bash
sudo kubeadm init --config /etc/kubeadm/kubeadm-config.yaml --upload-certs
mkdir -p $HOME/.kube
sudo cp -i /etc/kubernetes/admin.conf $HOME/.kube/config
sudo chown $(id -u):$(id -g) $HOME/.kube/config
```

oncall-bot: NOTE: Region eu-central-2 quota for A100 reported at 9 available GPUs. Consider requesting increase before nodepool scaling to 12.

maya: Thanks bot. I'll open a quota request. For now we'll provision a 4-node A100 pool as baseline.

sophie: After kubeadm init, I'll apply calico daemonset with `vxlan` mode turned off (we're using wireguard overlay) and set `MTU: 1420` in calico configmap.

liam: Add to infra checklist: allow TCP 2379-2380 between control plane instances, and UDP 51820 for WireGuard between peers. Also ensure port 10250 open from our SRE CIDR for kubelet metrics.

maya: Node join example (GPU node):
```bash
# on worker
sudo kubeadm join 10.120.0.10:6443 --token <token> --discovery-token-ca-cert-hash sha256:<hash> \
  --node-name gpu-worker-01 --cri-socket /var/run/containerd/containerd.sock
# then label/taint
kubectl label node gpu-worker-01 hardware=gpu
kubectl taint node gpu-worker-01 gpu-node=true:NoSchedule
```

sophie: I'll also add a poddefault that injects `--gpus=all` for test jobs and a limitrange so training pods don't run out-of-memory by default.

maya: Validation steps after nodes join:
- `kubectl get nodes` (should show Ready)
- `kubectl get pods -A` (coredns, calico, metrics-server all Ready)
- run GPU smoke pod: `nvidia-smi` inside container
- run small latency test hitting our inference health endpoint through LB (p50 < 40ms)

maya: Example GPU smoke pod YAML (one-off):
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: gpu-smoke
spec:
  restartPolicy: Never
  containers:
  - name: smoke
    image: nvcr.io/nvidia/cuda:11.8.0-cudnn8-runtime-ubuntu20.04
    command: ["/bin/bash", "-c", "nvidia-smi && sleep 2"]
    resources:
      limits:
        nvidia.com/gpu: 1
```

raj: After you run those, I'll validate routing by tracerouteing from central to a worker IP and ensure wireguard tunnels carry the traffic.

maya: I'll push nodepool and run kube-proxy + coredns e2e check. If anything fails, call out in this thread with `@oncall-sre`.

deploy-bot: Deployment plan created: cluster/eu-central-2/kubeadm/2026-03-18 by maya. Preview: 3 control-plane, 4 a100-worker, 2 a10g-spot.

sophie: Cost note: A100 reserved baseline ~ $X/hr per GPU, recommend mixing with A10G spot for batch workloads to keep steady-state cost down. Documenting tags: `team:inference`, `env:staging` -> billing export.
summary: kubeadm GPU cluster first-touch runbook + small bootstrap checklist with WireGuard MTU, node labels/taints, calico MTU config, quota check and handoff notes
